groups.activity: unlock the Zariman and The Holdfasts
groups.meta: The New War → Angels of the Zariman
conditions: There is no drop-table route: The Holdfasts on the Zariman are the sole source of Praedos' blueprint and its dedicated materials.

groups.sub: Chrysalith: turn Voidplumes in to Archimedean Yonta
groups.activity: Exterminate; finish the objective, then full-clear the map and kill its Angel

rows.label: Voidplume Pinion
rows.note: build requirement; one per dormant Void Angel

rows.label: Voidplume Crest
rows.note: Rank 3 tribute; one guaranteed per map

conditions: Rank 4 (Seraph) requires 99,000 cumulative standing. The rank-up tributes additionally need 5 Down, 10 Vane, 10 Crest, and 15 Quill; bank crafting materials before donating plumes.
The daily cap is 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank. Down, Vane, and Crest may bypass that cap as medallions, but treat that as unconfirmed; Quills and Pinions are safer kept for requirements.
Each normal Zariman mission has a dormant Void Angel that drops one Pinion. Void Armageddon instead has a Ravenous Angel that drops a Quill, so do not use it for Pinions.
Container-break with loot radar, collect Lost Spirit trails after the objective, and redeem Zarium Accolades at Melica consoles. Squad pickups are shared.
bonuses: Parallax's Orokin Eye marks nearby Voidplumes; Helminth Golden Instinct is the free alternative.
Void Cascade is a strong simultaneous source of Thrax Plasm for rank-up and crafting requirements.

disclosures.title: this is a standing wall plus 15 Angel kills
disclosures.body: The blueprint is not RNG-gated, but Rank 4 is a multi-day daily-cap grind and 15 Pinions require at least 15 dormant Angels. A thorough Exterminate is the flexible all-in-one route.

conditions: Trading skips the Rank 4 blueprint purchase, but it does not skip the Zariman-only materials required to build Praedos.
You may craft Praedos before Mastery Rank 14, but cannot equip it until then. The Foundry result is an unevolved tonfa; its Incarnon progression comes next.

groups.meta: no Genesis adapter or Circuit rotation needed

rows.label: Incarnon Form activations in one mission
rows.note: Evolution II; activate at 5x combo then Heavy Attack

rows.label: Heavy Attacks on Thrax Centurions or Legates
Solo mission with an Incarnon weapon in every slot

conditions: Apply each unlocked evolution before the next tier begins tracking. Evolution progress otherwise persists across missions.
Evolution II requires six separate activations in one mission; short Exterminates are a poor fit.
For Evolution III, the Heavy Attack must hit Thrax Centurions or Legates in their killable state. Void Cascade naturally supplies both targets and Thrax Plasm.
Evolution V requires three Incarnon weapons and solo completion. Exalted weapons do not qualify; native Incarnons or Incarnon Genesis weapons do.
bonuses: Choose Drifting Grace at Evolution II and Evolved Ascension at Evolution IV for Praedos' celebrated passive +20% sprint/slide speed and +30% Parkour Velocity.
Swift Transmute at Evolution IV lowers future Incarnon activation to 3x combo, but gives up the passive parkour option.

disclosures.title: the movement perks are the prize
disclosures.body: Praedos is often equipped without ever being swung: Drifting Grace and Evolved Ascension remain active just by carrying it. The native Incarnon upgrades are a second progression track after crafting, not an adapter farm.
